properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of XML namespaces in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified XMLNamespaces object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual XMLNamespace object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position or a String representing the name of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Path As String, [NamespaceURI As Variant], [Alias As Variant], [InstallForAllUsers As Boolean]) As XMLNamespace
methods.description: Returns an XMLNamespace object that represents a schema that is added to the Schema Library and made available to users in Microsoft Word.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The path and file name of the schema. This may be a local file path, a network path, or an Internet address.

parameters.name: NamespaceURI
parameters.description: The namespace Uniform Resource Indicator as specified in the schema. The NamespaceURI parameter is case-sensitive and must be spelled exactly as specified in schema.

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.description: The name of the schema as it appears on the Schemas tab in the Templates and Add-ins dialog box.

parameters.name: InstallForAllUsers
parameters.description: True if all users that log on to a computer can access and use the new schema. The default is False.

methods.name: InstallManifest
methods.description: Installs the specified XML expansion pack on the user's computer, making an XML smart document solution available to one or more users.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The path and file name of the XML expansion pack.

parameters.name: InstallForAllUsers
parameters.description: True installs the XML expansion pack and makes it available to all users on a computer. False makes the XML expansion pack available for the current user only. Default is False.
